_comment: Expansion 6 G.3: what the world keeps of a tale (game/story/consequences.py): the numbers of the ruin in full, the townsfolk's fates, newcomers, a holding's rent, a letter's weight, a song's reach; and the words of monuments, new names, relics, laws, holdings, letters and songs at inns. {hero} is the hero's first name; {villain}, {villain_short}, {beast}, {home} and {town} are the tale's.

monument_beast: Here {hero} killed {villain_short}, that took our sheep and our children. Let no one forget either.
To {hero}, who went into the dark at {home} and came back with {villain_short}'s head.
{villain_short} is dead. Raised by the people of {town} in thanks to {hero}.
For those {villain_short} took, and for {hero}, who ended it.
monument_gibbet: An iron cage hangs from the gibbet, and in it what is left of a captain of {gang}. A board beneath says: so end all who rob these roads.
The cage on the gibbet creaks in the wind. Somebody has chalked on the post: taken by {hero}, hanged by the lord.
A gibbet with a cage, and a captain of {gang} in it. The crows have been at him; the carters touch their caps as they pass.
monument_risen: Here {villain_short} sleeps at last. {hero} laid {him} down. Light a candle, and walk on.
A shrine to the dead of {home}, who walk no more. The people of {town} keep its candle lit.
For the {king} who walked, and for {hero}, who sent {him} back to the dark.
Rest. Cut beneath, in a rougher hand: and stay there.
relic_beast: tusk of {villain_short}, as long as a hand
relic_risen: rusted sword of the {king} who walked
ring of {villain_short}, cold to the touch
relic_risen_hero: black ring of {villain_short}, that no longer burns
cause_failed: put aside by their own people, who said they did nothing while {town} suffered
stepped down, broken by what happened to {town}
cause_risen: taken by the dead of {home}, on the night {town} fell
dragged into the dark by {villain_short}'s dead
ruin_news: {place} has fallen. The few who are left live in the shells of their houses, and bury their dead.
{place} is a ruin now. Those who could fled down the roads; the rest are in the ground.
There is no town at {place} any more: roofless walls, open doors, new graves and a handful who stayed.
{place} fell, and nobody came. What is left would not fill a village.
law_harshness: {realm} hardens its law: since the business with {gang}, justice in its lands is {value}.
In the lands of {realm} the gallows are busy now. Its justice is {value}, they say, and shamed into it.
{realm} has changed its law after {gang}: its judges are {value} now, and the roads are watched.
land_name: a holding near {place}, with three farms and a mill
the manor of Hollin Garth, near {place}
a farmstead and its fields outside {place}
lands on the river by {place}, with tenants who pay on quarter days
letter_line: To all who serve {realm}: the bearer, {hero}, has done this realm a service it will not forget. Help them as you would help me.
Whoever reads this, in {realm}'s name: open your doors to {hero}, who did for {place} what we could not.
Let {hero} pass, and be given what they need. I answer for them myself.
The bearer is a friend of {realm}. Treat them as one, or answer to me.
song_at_inn: After the meal {singer} sings {title}. The whole room knows the chorus; some of them glance at you.
Someone calls for {title}, and {singer} obliges. It is about you, more or less, and the room cheers the end.
{singer} sings {title} by the fire. They have made you taller in it, and braver; nobody asks you if it is true.
The room goes quiet for {title}. When {singer} is done, a man at the next table raises his cup to you.
